lines.say: This is G Y E Video, a factory for Doe-yin English learning shorts.
lines.caption: This is GYEVideo: a factory for Douyin English-learning shorts.

lines.say: Eighty-three episodes. Three content lines. And exactly one Remotion template.
lines.caption: 83 episodes. 3 content lines. Exactly 1 Remotion template.

lines.say: The core rule: never copy the Remotion project.
lines.caption: The core rule: never copy the Remotion project.

lines.say: Each video is a small episode package of data files. Plug it into the one template, and out comes a finished video.
lines.caption: Each video is a small episode package. Plug it into the one template, get a finished video.

lines.say: There are three content lines.
lines.caption: There are three content lines.

lines.say: Fifty-nine word root episodes. Twenty sentence episodes that fix Chinglish. And four scene vocabulary read-alongs.
lines.caption: 59 word-root episodes · 20 sentence episodes · 4 scene-vocab read-alongs

lines.say: Word root videos teach one root at a time. Take man, and man-you. It means hand.
lines.caption: Word-root videos teach one root at a time: man / manu = hand.

lines.say: A big hook, words orbiting in sync with the voice, then the root reveal, word cards, and a connected grid.
lines.caption: Big hook → orbiting words → root reveal → word cards → connected grid.

lines.say: Episode forty-six is the visual benchmark every new episode is compared against.
lines.caption: Episode 046 is the benchmark every new episode is compared against.

lines.say: Sentence videos run in Chinglish Trap mode.
lines.caption: Sentence videos run in “Chinglish Trap” mode.

lines.say: A wrong expression gets punished on screen, the meaning twists, and a natural fix slams in.
lines.caption: Wrong expression → meaning twist → native fix slams in.

lines.say: Long time no see is fine with friends. With a client, try: it's been a while.
lines.caption: “Long time no see” with friends. With a client: “It's been a while.”

lines.say: Read-along videos tell a relatable Chinese story, like staying up until two in the morning, with ten to twelve English words built in.
lines.caption: Read-alongs: a relatable Chinese story with 10–12 English words built in.

lines.say: As each word is read, it lights up, and a card shows its phonetics, meaning, and scene.
lines.caption: Each word lights up as it's read, with a card for phonetics, meaning and scene.

lines.say: Every episode package has the same shape.
lines.caption: Every episode package has the same shape.

lines.say: A brief. A data folder with the config, the voice script, and the word or sentence data. Then audio, exports, and notes.
lines.caption: brief.md · data/ (config, voice script, content) · audio/ · exports/ · notes.md

lines.say: Production takes four commands.
lines.caption: Production takes four commands.

lines.say: Episode use syncs a package into the template.
lines.caption: episode:use syncs a package into the template.

lines.say: Voice calls Dash Scope Cozy Voice, measures every line with F F probe, and writes a real timeline, so the visuals follow the actual narration.
lines.caption: voice: DashScope CosyVoice → ffprobe timing → a real timeline the visuals follow.

lines.say: Then preview, and render exports the video, cover, caption, and publish notes.
lines.caption: preview, then render: video, cover, caption and publish notes.

lines.say: The creative rules live in project skills for AI coding agents.
lines.caption: The creative rules live in project skills for AI coding agents.

lines.say: Three skills, and more than forty reference files, cover hooks, rhythm, subtitles and voice, plus rules like anti P P T, and boring video killer.
lines.caption: 3 skills · 40+ reference files: hooks, rhythm, subtitles, voice, anti-PPT, boring-video-killer

lines.say: Shared assets hold background music and forty-seven animal icons, and a bank of one hundred college life stories feeds new scenes.
lines.caption: Shared BGM, 47 animal icons, and a bank of 100 college-life stories.

lines.say: Before anything ships: a type check, a contact sheet review, no text overflow, and music that never buries the voice.
lines.caption: QA: type check · contact sheet · no overflow · BGM never buries the voice

lines.say: Generated audio, exports, and A P I keys stay out of git.
lines.caption: Generated audio, exports and API keys stay out of git.

lines.say: Install, pick an episode, generate the voice, and render. That's G Y E Video.
lines.caption: Install → pick an episode → voice → render. That's GYEVideo.
